description: Legal, regulatory, and contractual cybersecurity requirements are not understood and managed.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of legal and regulatory requirement inventories, missing compliance tracking mechanisms, lack of documented privacy and civil liberties obligations, no evidence of contractual cybersecurity requirement management, absence of legal counsel involvement in cybersecurity governance.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
